question: Deomali mountain peak is in :
solution: The correct answer is __**Odisha.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The Deomali (1672m) mountain peak is situated on the Eastern Ghat in Odisha. • It is the highest peak of Odisha. • Deomali is a mountain peak in the Chandragiri-Pottangi subrange of the Eastern Ghats. • It is located near Koraput town in the Koraput district of southern Odisha, India.
